_ordering_rationale: P&C insurance core metrics: premiums (auto + home), combined ratio, catastrophe losses. Specifique secteur assurance dommages.

kpis.signal: Coeur Allstate, repricing massif 2023-2024 pour restaurer la marge auto
kpis.description_fr: Primes auto emises (Allstate Protection). Plus grand segment Allstate, en hausse via rate increases pour absorber l'inflation reparations.
kpis.description_en: Auto premiums written (Allstate Protection). Largest segment, growing via rate hikes to absorb claim inflation.

kpis.signal: Croissance forte primes habitation post-inflation et hausse exposition catastrophes
kpis.description_fr: Primes habitation et autres dommages biens. Hausse via repricing apres inflation reconstruction et hausse expositions cat nat.
kpis.description_en: Homeowners and other property premiums. Growth via repricing for reconstruction inflation and rising cat-nat exposure.

kpis.signal: Volatilite climatique structurelle, pic 2023, normalisation partielle 2024
kpis.description_fr: Pertes liees aux evenements catastrophiques (ouragans, tornades, grele, incendies). KPI structurel P&C en hausse tendancielle climat.
kpis.description_en: Losses from catastrophic events (hurricanes, tornadoes, hail, wildfires). Structural P&C KPI, rising trend with climate.

kpis.signal: Retour sous 100 en 2024, profitability technique restauree apres 2 ans rouge
kpis.description_fr: Ratio combine Property-Liability = loss ratio + expense ratio. <100 = profitable techniquement. 94.3 en 2024 vs 104.6 en 2023.
kpis.description_en: Property-Liability combined ratio = loss + expense ratio. <100 = underwriting profit. 94.3 FY24 vs 104.6 FY23.

kpis.signal: Top line P&C en hausse continue, rate increases auto/home portent la croissance
kpis.description_fr: Primes brutes Property-Liability emises (auto + home + autres). Croissance soutenue via tarifs.
kpis.description_en: Gross Property-Liability premiums written (auto + home + others). Sustained growth via tariffs.

_notes: Donnees 10-K Allstate Corp FY20-FY24. FY20 auto/home estimes/extrapoles partiellement (10-K 2021 montre segments restructures). Combined ratio FY20-FY21 incluent impact COVID.
